U.visual_disposition: ACCEPT at original small stylized game scope

components.evidence: Shared start/restart and native A clips show a consistent low canopy, integrated rear fascia/wing, tire placement and narrow side framing. Exposed open-wheel structure reads consistently; no torn/unfinished join established.
components.caveat: Dark upper body and tire faces hide some structure; no photoreal surface treatment expected.

components.evidence: Native B motion/finish clips show uninterrupted cream edge/shoulder and continuous orange tubular rails meeting repeated posts. Shared brake has a locally sharp inside bend but no open hole or disconnected surface.
components.caveat: Faceted corner transitions remain visible at close range.

components.evidence: Flat layered sea/beach/ground and shaded faceted cliff masses are consistent across all seven full frames.
components.caveat: Large generic cliff volumes and low secondary structure make the landscape sparse; this is a style/detail limitation, not an established major finishing defect under the tiny prompt.

components.evidence: Shared frames and native C finish/restart clips show readable number groups, contained progress bar, aligned status and complete footer mappings.
components.caveat: Small secondary finish text and large persistent title are proportionate presentation limitations, not clipping.

components.evidence: Countdown, drive progress, finish, reset and resume are distinct and visually consistent.

W.visual_disposition: ACCEPT as a basic coherent toy-style small game, with detail limitations; player-facing controls require revision

components.disposition: BASIC/PASS for small-game finish; V2 unearned
components.evidence: All states retain consistent complete toy-car forms with cabin/body/wheels/taillights. Flat slabs remain visually generic and do not establish authored refinement beyond basic stand-ins.
components.caveat: Drive and steer collision frames overlap cars substantially, reducing separation. Without temporal evidence, persistent broken collision presentation is not established; do not infer duration.

components.evidence: Shared frames show continuous flat road, dashed lane marks and alternating curb strips with no visible surface tears.
components.caveat: Repeated straight corridor does not earn V1.

components.evidence: Plain towers with neon strips/glows and coarse palm-like forms maintain consistent night-city styling.
components.caveat: Broad dark unarticulated surfaces and repeated primitive forms limit finishing distinction, contributing to V2=0; coherent stylization itself is not a defect.

components.evidence: Start button/Enter cue, separated HUD groups, collision notice and result/replay modal are legible without visible clipping.
components.caveat: Secondary labels are small; scene darkness hides some geometry.

components.evidence: W/start.png, drive.png, steer.png, brake.png, complete.png, restart.png and resume.png all show accelerate/left/right/nitro but omit the tested ArrowDown brake.
components.caveat: A working but undiscoverable brake is a player-facing instruction gap, not a fatal runtime failure.

components.evidence: Start, play feedback and retained finish/countdown/resume distinguish states and preserve best time.
components.caveat: Terminal evidence is retained, and motion cadence unverified.

revise_findings.scope: Driving control legend across all seven W full-frame states
revise_findings.finding: The tested ArrowDown braking action has no visible instruction. This fails strict I2 and leaves one primary driving action undiscoverable.

visual_preference.reason: Warm coastal color separation, readable changing road geometry, orange rail/cream edge rhythm and more considered low sports-car form make U more visually resolved at delivery size. W has a pleasing dark/neon Arabic race presentation and richer visible traffic challenge, but flatter generic geometry and darker surfaces.

material_caveats: No genuine temporal evidence exists; both R4=0/unverified, not observed failure.

Assessment inspects supplied pixels/public observations, not generator logs/source or independently served builds. Served source digests/server timestamps are not supplied here; pixel-manifest records screenshot hashes.
W current start/drive/steer/brake samples and retained earlier unchanged-source complete/restart/resume are separate evidence windows.

Log HUD readings and PNG HUD readings are not atomic. W steer log134 km/h versus PNG077 is a material snapshot mismatch; use them for directional outcomes, not precise instantaneous speed or a performance comparison.
U font CSS request is blocked but no required gameplay resource or fatal failure is demonstrated.
U extra native crops are separate finishing evidence available only for U. Do not award a common score solely from these crops, compare their crop scale to W, or treat them as motion clips.
Different race lengths/goals mean completion times are not a matched speed benchmark. No general causal claim or generation-method inference follows from this two-artifact comparison.

No major broken visual finishing component is established for U at the original tiny stylized scope. W's precise REVISE finding is control-instruction completeness; its missing V2 point is a visual-detail limitation rather than proof that simple styling is invalid.
